p='/home/user/EntireSummerSales.xlsx'

        for si in root.findall('a:si',ns):

        vals=[]
        for c in row.findall('a:c',ns):
            ref=c.attrib.get('r')
            t=c.attrib.get('t')
            v=c.find('a:v',ns)
            val=v.text if v is not None else ''
            if t=='s' and val"'!='"'': val=sst[int(val)]
            vals.append((ref,val))
        print(vals)

import uno, time, subprocess, os, signal, sys
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue

url='file://' + p

time.sleep(1)
proc=subprocess.Popen(['libreoffice','--headless','--invisible',\"--accept=socket,host=127.0.0.1,port=2002;urp;\",'--norestore','--nofirststartwizard'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
local_ctx=uno.getComponentContext(); smgr=local_ctx.ServiceManager
resolver=smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
ctx=None
last=None
for i in range(40):
    try:
        ctx=resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=127.0.0.1,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
        break
    except Exception as e:
        last=e
        time.sleep(0.25)
if ctx is None:
    out,err=proc.communicate(timeout=2) if proc.poll() is not None else (b'',b'')
    raise RuntimeError(f'could not connect: {last}; stdout={out"'!r}; stderr={err!r}'"')
try:
    desktop=ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
    props=[]
    for name,val in [('Hidden', True),('ReadOnly', False)]:
        pv=PropertyValue(); pv.Name=name; pv.Value=val; props.append(pv)
    doc=desktop.loadComponentFromURL(url, '_blank', 0, tuple(props))
    if doc is None:
        raise RuntimeError('LibreOffice could not load workbook')
    sheets=doc.Sheets
    sh=sheets.getByIndex(0)
    cur=sh.createCursor(); cur.gotoEndOfUsedArea(True)
    used=cur.RangeAddress
    if sheets.hasByName('Sheet2'):
        sheets.removeByName('Sheet2')
    sheets.insertNewByName('Sheet2', sheets.Count)
    out_sheet=sheets.getByName('Sheet2')
    dps=out_sheet.getDataPilotTables()
    desc=dps.createDataPilotDescriptor()
    src=CellRangeAddress(); src.Sheet=0; src.StartColumn=0; src.StartRow=0; src.EndColumn=6; src.EndRow=used.EndRow
    desc.SourceRange=src
    fields=desc.getDataPilotFields()
    COLUMN=uno.Enum('com.sun.star.sheet.DataPilotFieldOrientation','COLUMN')
    DATA=uno.Enum('com.sun.star.sheet.DataPilotFieldOrientation','DATA')
    SUM=uno.Enum('com.sun.star.sheet.GeneralFunction','SUM')
    fields.getByName('Promotion').Orientation=COLUMN
    revenue=fields.getByName('Revenue')
    revenue.Orientation=DATA
    revenue.Function=SUM
    dest=out_sheet.getCellByPosition(0,0).CellAddress
    dps.insertNewByName('Promotion Revenue Pivot', dest, desc)
    out_sheet.getCellRangeByName('A1:Z20').Columns.OptimalWidth=True
    doc.store()
    doc.close(True)
    print('created pivot table in Sheet2')
finally:
    try:
        desktop.terminate()
    except Exception:
        pass
    time.sleep(1)
    if proc.poll() is None:
        proc.terminate()
PY"

    print('pivot files:', [n for n in names if 'pivot' in n.lower()])
